events.name: Foot Foot
events.description:
Uncover Music presents

Foot Foot

foot foot are Esther Pollock (vocals, guitar), Llyr Cox (drums), Ethan Poole (bass), Amelia Gilmartin (violin) and Evo Ethel (sax, woodwind).

Formed in the summer of 2021, foot foot were initially a folk duo, later joined by Esther's older brother (Jesse Pollock) and Llyr for their first 'proper' show at Dot2Dot, later recruiting saxophonist Evo Ethel (Ex Agent) and violinist Amelia Gilmartin.

Since then, foot foot have established themselves as one of the leading acts of Bristol's underground, drawing on the traditions of folk, math-rock, and discordant post-rock to produce their intricate brand of songcraft, creating moments of serenity and stillness before launching into fast, jagged rhythms. Their use of contrasts - indie-flecked songwriting with irregular, winding passages, or rich violin and vocal melodies with avante-jazz freakouts - have marked them out as one of the scene's most innovative and impactful live acts.

They have earned themselves support slots alongside artists such as Deerhoof, Horse Jumper of Love, The Bug Club, Leatherhead and Quade to name a few, and on the lineups of many indie festivals (Simple Things, Ritual Union, Outer Town, Dot2Dot, etc).

Their debut album "still waters, empty house," recorded over 7 days in the basement of iconic music venue The Louisiana, produced by Jack Ogbourne (Bingo Fury, The Cindys) was released in February 2025 to critical acclaim. The album consists of 7 songs that seek to encapsulate the process of discovering one's own unique voice. A breakup album at heart, foot foot navigates themes of isolation, unrequited love, and human nature with lyrics that blossom and wilt upon a terrain of distorted guitars, lush violin, fragile vocals and whiplash inducing time signatures.

events.name: Lady Nade
events.description:
Uncover Music presents

Lady Nade

Experience multi award-winning songstress Lady Nade live as she brings her highly anticipated album Identity to the stage. Blending roots, folk, soul, Americana, jazz, blues and pop, the show offers sanctuary, encouragement and a powerful celebration of self-love and self-expression.

Featuring the anthemic BBC Introducing Song of the Week 'One Of Us'; the soul-soothing 'Rainbow'; and the retro-infused, inspired pop of 'Sober', as championed by Cerys Matthews on BBC Radio 6 Music. Identity is about being seen, being heard, and discovering the freedom of fully inhabiting who you are.

Lady Nade writes with honesty and vulnerability, balancing emotional depth with warmth, positivity and hope. As noted by Americana UK, her music is rooted in lived experience and a belief in its power to foster connection, compassion and healing.

Joined by a six-piece band of some of the UK's finest musicians, this is an evening designed for connection, reflection and shared experience.

events.name: Antwerp Gipsy Ska Orkestra
events.description:
Uncover Music presents 

Antwerp Gipsy Ska Orkestra

Antwerp has, with its rich history and international port, always been a melting pot of cultures, a place where people from all over the world meet and exchange ideas.

As amazing as their records may be, Antwerp Gispy Ska Orkestra is first and foremost a stunning live band that has thrilled audiences throughout Europe, including Ukraine, Spain, Portugal, Italy, the UK, France, Switzerland, Austria, Hungary, Czech Republic, The Netherlands and of course their home country Belgium. They have even played in Ulan-Ude, the capital of the Republic of Buryatia (Russia), probably the most Siberian part of Siberia.

They have performed at famous festivals such as Dour, Lowlands, Sziget (twice) and Life Festival Oswiecim, and have opened for such legendary artists as Peter Gabriel.

They celebrated their 20-year anniversary in 2023. "We play a unique genre that we invented ourselves", says band leader Gregor Engelen. "Although musicians in Venezuela - of all places - have started a band too. And worst of all: we played with them several times and they are just fantastic. Then there's this gypsy band in Kosovo that covers several of our (cover) songs.." "I not only sing in Dutch, French and English, but in Romani as well. I don't actually speak Romani, even though I slowly start to understand bits of conversation. It's a relatively poor language with a limited number of words and a basic grammar, but if you want to learn it you need to go and live with gypsies, as there are no Romani dictionaries or language courses."

The latest album Revolution (Has Never Been Simple) was released with a European tour in 2024, and was produced by Alain Croisy AKA Lunaman and Jamie Evans.

Kazeem Jamal - Locked and loaded ready to release fire on his razor sharp humour as a true breath of fresh air for the UK’s industry. A raconteur proving himself to be a fine addition to the comedy circuit.
Jamie Dsouza - "D’Souza projects a similar millennial everyperson appeal" Chortle
Dave Twentyman - "He deflects the heckles with wit as well as making sure the acts get a rousing reception" - Lancashire Life Magazine "Fantastic & Friendly" - The Northern Echo

We open from 6.45pm so you can have a pre show chat and grab some drinks from the bar.  Our shows start at 8pm, so you get your laughs in then make further plans for the night, your ticket includes entry into Rosies after the show.
